definitions.explanation: A motorcycle. A somewhat older or colloquial word, originally distinguishing a solo motorcycle from one with a sidecar.

examples.japanese: {単車|たんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単車|たんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だった。
examples.english: When I was young I liked motorcycles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧、{単車|たんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本|にほん}{中|じゅう}→日本中：28045_nihonjuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: My father apparently traveled all over Japan by motorcycle long ago.

notes:
An older, somewhat colloquial word for a motorcycle. The name (literally 'single vehicle') originally contrasted a motorcycle alone with one fitted with a sidecar. It can sound dated; younger speakers usually say ⟦バイク→バイク：05081_baiku⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バイク→バイク：05081_baiku⟧: motorcycle — the standard everyday word today
- ⟦オートバイ→オートバイ：01774_ootobai⟧: motorcycle — slightly more formal, used in writing and traffic contexts
- ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧: bicycle — a different vehicle, not motorized
